text: To Steenbarger's hold: the one trigger I ratify is h1_close_above:bar_high on H1, an hourly close above yesterday's high, ACT_NOW. reclaim:ma_20 buys a pullback under the 20-day average, a buy on the reaction that C5 forbids; I hold that objection until it is replaced. TTEK is W HH/HL, D 0.98% under the 20-day high, 9>21 on all frames, VLTO confirms the group (C14). day_vol 1.14 is a proxy only to me (R5). Wrong if a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high prints (C7, my translation).
